concept.name: Speed
concept.description: Bell-curve structure: ascending from stationary to peak (fastest), then descending back to stopped. Peak at 50% = superlative maximum speed.
concept.notes: v1.1: Vocabulary restructured for bell-curve. Ascending (5–45%): stationary→fastest. Peak (50%): maximum speed. Descending (55–95%): not as fast→stopped. Transitions follow the same arc: starting off → accelerating → peaking → decelerating → full stop. v1.2: CRITICAL FIX — conceptData and transitionsData columns were in [SL,TL] order (reversed from the suite-wide [TL,SL,Quiz,Position] convention). Corrected so column[0]=TL (Diam etc), column[1]=SL (Stationary etc).
